items.name: Funnel cake
items.description: Fresh-fried dough under a snowfall of powdered sugar, with fruit toppings available. The midway classic, done in the classic way.
items.verdict: Worth it once per trip at close, ideally shared — the sugar and the fried smell are inseparable from the park at night.

items.name: Brisket plate
items.description: Sliced brisket with sides at the plaza smokehouse — the park's one real hot-meal answer.
items.verdict: The best savory stop at the park. Not destination barbecue, but honest portions at a fair theme-park price.

items.name: Churro
items.description: Cinnamon-sugar churro from the roaming carts — the queue-line-adjacent snack that survives every Six Flags menu change.
items.verdict: The best portable snack at the park. Buy it walking, not waiting.

items.name: Turkey leg
items.description: The smoked turkey leg the size of a toddler's arm, walked around the park on the theory that it is a meal.
items.verdict: Split it between two people or commit to being finished with food for the day. Salt-forward, photogenic, a theme-park rite.
